name: slopsentral
description: Source contracts and validation tooling for the Slopsentral plugin marketplace

scripts.check:source: node tools/validate-source-graph.mjs && node tools/catalog.mjs --check && git diff --check && git diff --cached --check && git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
scripts.verify: npm run check:python && npm run check:source && npm test && npm run verify:marketplaces
scripts.docs:check: uv run --locked --script tools/sync_docs.py --check && npm run docs:validate
scripts.docs:validate: cd docs/public && mint validate && mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects
